kings_guide.text: Look up. No, further. That is the largest fan vault in the world, twelve great bays of stone spread like open fans, and not one of them is holding anything up but itself.
Henry VI laid the first stone in 1446. Then came the Wars of the Roses, and the money ran out, and it took three more kings and nearly seventy years to finish.
The stained glass is the finest set of its age in England. In the Second World War they took it all down, piece by piece, and hid it. Then put it all back. Nobody lost a single saint.

kings_chorister.text: Every Christmas Eve we sing A Festival of Nine Lessons and Carols, and millions listen on the radio round the world.
It always starts with one boy singing the first verse of Once in Royal David's City, alone. He's only told it's him a moment before. No pressure.

kings_visitor.text: Behind the altar there's a Rubens, The Adoration of the Magi. A man paid a fortune for it in 1961 and gave it to the college.
I've been staring at the ceiling so long my neck has gone. Worth it, mind.
